categories.conditional_target_mapping: An explicit preselected or host-controlled outcome plus conditional retain/discard of selections to reach it.
categories.insufficient_information: No unique rule is claimed; uncertainty is expressed.
categories.other_hypothesis: A different process is proposed; it may remain observationally plausible.
categories.target_only: A fixed or host-chosen outcome is proposed without a conditional mapping account.

coding: exploratory single-coordinator coding; preserve raw answers; no private-inference claim
uncertainty: Keep uncertainty; do not grade a plausible alternative as a reasoning failure solely because the hidden generator differs.
